command: cooperbench run -n solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-core-stepcounter -s core -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m gemini/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/variants/stepcounter.yaml --setting solo -c 8 --backend docker
agent_config:
# Variant config: show "Step n of N: k left" on every turn (agent.step_counter, off by default).
# Same as the reference config otherwise (upstream step limit and compaction).
# Pass via: AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/stepcounter.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=stepcounter tools/run.sh solo ...
agent:
  cost_limit: 10.0
  step_counter: true

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: high
      includeThoughts: true
